title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 01 AUGUST 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 01 August 2026. Due to the active Southwest monsoon, the prevailing rainy and windy conditions over the southwestern parts of the island will continue today. Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places. A few showers may occur in Matale, Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Northern, North-central, Central and North-western provinces and in Monaragala and Trincomalee districts.
